name: Yap MCP
description: MCP server and CLI that transcribes audio and video files on the user's computer with NVIDIA Parakeet TDT v3 (sherpa-onnx) and searches the local Yap dictation history.
limitations: The first transcription downloads a speech model of about 670 MB.
Requires Node.js 20 or newer (22.13 or newer for search_dictations).
search_dictations reads the history of the separate Yap dictation app, which is closed source and paid.

sources.note: Describes the tools, local-only processing, supported platforms, install paths and the one-time model download.
